q: What is the first, lowest-code way to add a capability to Hermes?
options: Write a custom tool from scratch
Install a plugin with a single command
explanation: Plugins bundle features you enable with one command — check for a plugin before building anything custom.

q: What does MCP stand for and do?
options: Model Context Protocol — the standard for connecting AI to external tools and data
explanation: The Model Context Protocol is the emerging standard for connecting agents to external tools and data sources.

q: What is the recommended order when choosing an extension?
explanation: Use a plugin first, then an MCP bridge, and only write a custom tool for something truly unique to your workflow.

q: Which of these best describes what an MCP connector can give your agent?
options: A pre-trained memory of your whole life
Live, structured access to an external service's tools and data
explanation: MCP servers expose an external service's real tools and data to the agent, so it can act on live systems through one standard.
